cpuProtocol.scope: isolated Chrome tree including browser, renderer, GPU-process CPU, utilities, fixture and CDP overhead
cpuProtocol.numerator: sum of cpuRaw after.cpuTime minus before.cpuTime in seconds for identical process identities and types
cpuProtocol.denominator: recorded cpu.elapsedMs enclosing the sample; distinct from in-page durationMs
cpuProtocol.statistics: descriptive only; three rounds per group; no benefit inference

unmeasured: current-build five-round comparison in this dataset
